## 🧩 Rare Mobs 

This resource pack is a vanilla-styled minimalist mob overhaul inspired by the original vision of Minecraft and its creator _Markus Persson_. The goal of the project is to carefully redesign mobs in a clean, minimalistic style while preserving their iconic features, atmosphere, and gameplay identity.

Every mob is recreated with respect to the early development history of the game. Their appearance reflects how they were originally imagined by the developers — simple, readable, slightly mysterious, and fully integrated into the vanilla aesthetic. This is not a radical redesign, but a refined return to the roots.


---

## 🦆 Currently Available Mobs

- Creeper
 
- Skeleton
  
- Spider
  
- Zombie


Each of them keeps their recognizable silhouette, proportions, and core visual traits, but with a smoother, more minimal execution that fits seamlessly into the vanilla world.


---

The goal is to gradually rework most vanilla mobs while keeping consistency, balance, and respect for their original design philosophy.


---

## Development Status

The resource pack is currently in active development. More mobs and refinements are coming in future updates. Feedback, suggestions, and constructive criticism are highly appreciated — your input helps shape the direction of the project and improve its quality.

This pack is a tribute to the early design spirit of Minecraft, preserving the development history and presenting mobs as they were originally envisioned by the developers and Notch — simple, iconic, and timeless.
